description: Curated national specialty providers. Selective, maintained by hand; every entry must be checked against the provider's own published services and given a verifiedAt date. Entries with intentEligible false are kept only for the legacy luxury clothing results.

providers.name: The RealReal
providers.notes: Consigns authenticated luxury goods across fashion, jewelry, watches, art, and home. Commission is tiered; confirm current terms and what they accept before sending anything.
questionsToAsk: Do you accept this item and brand right now?
What commission applies to this category and price?
How long is the consignment period, and what happens if it does not sell?
providers.verificationSource: Public seller guidance and reporting reviewed 2026-10-16 (consignment model; mail-in, pickup, and drop-off intake).

legacyLuxuryHub.website_snippet: Luxury consignment channel with mail-in / concierge-style intake options; authentication-oriented workflow (verify current programs).
legacyLuxuryHub.place_details: Hub/national channel. Often a better fit than local consignment for Remembered/Luxury brands in secondary markets.

providers.name: Vestiaire Collective
providers.notes: Carried over from the luxury clothing list. Not yet re-verified, so it is not offered in specialty searches.

legacyLuxuryHub.website_snippet: Designer fashion resale marketplace; authentication pathways are part of the model (verify process for your item type and region).
legacyLuxuryHub.place_details: Hub/online channel. Shipping is often easier than driving, even in major cities.

providers.name: Grailed (Menswear)
providers.notes: Carried over from the luxury clothing list. Not yet re-verified, so it is not offered in specialty searches.

legacyLuxuryHub.website_snippet: Menswear-focused resale marketplace; best for specific menswear brands/styles (verify selling workflow and fees).
legacyLuxuryHub.place_details: Online channel; useful when local luxury demand is weak or inconsistent.

providers.name: Fashionphile
providers.serviceArea: Nationwide (mail-in), US; selling studios in some cities
providers.notes: Offers an outright quote or consignment for designer bags and accessories. Authentication happens after the item arrives.
questionsToAsk: Is an outright offer or consignment better for this item?
Do you accept it in its current condition?
When and how is payment made?
providers.verificationSource: Fashionphile selling and consignment pages reviewed 2026-10-16 (online quote with prepaid shipping or UPS pickup; consignment option).

providers.name: KEH Camera
providers.notes: Buys used cameras and lenses outright after an online quote; ships with a prepaid label. Gear is inspected and graded on arrival, which can change the offer. Not a consignor.
questionsToAsk: What is your quote for this body and lens?
How could your inspection grade change the offer?
Is free pickup available for this order?
providers.verificationSource: KEH selling guidance and independent reviews checked 2026-10-16 (quote, prepaid FedEx label, inspection and grading).

providers.name: MPB
providers.notes: Buys or trades in used cameras, lenses, and video gear; free insured FedEx shipping. The quote can change after inspection. Not a consignor.
questionsToAsk: What is your quote for this gear?
How could inspection change the quote?
How quickly is payment made after you receive it?
providers.verificationSource: MPB selling page reviewed 2026-10-16 (paid or trade-in, free insured FedEx shipping, quote adjusted after inspection).

providers.name: Worthy
providers.notes: Runs online auctions to professional buyers for diamonds, fine jewelry, and luxury watches. Fees are a percentage of a completed sale; you can decline if bids fall short of your reserve.
questionsToAsk: Does this piece qualify for your auctions?
What fee applies at the expected price?
How is the item insured in transit and returned if it does not sell?
providers.verificationSource: Worthy home page reviewed 2026-10-16 (auction to professional buyers, tiered fees on completed sales, insured mail-in and return).

providers.name: Reverb
providers.notes: A marketplace for music gear: you list, sell, and ship the item yourself. A selling fee and payment processing fee apply when it sells. Not a consignor or buyer.
providers.verificationSource: Reverb selling and fee pages reviewed 2026-10-16 (free listing; selling fee plus payment processing on sale).
